headline: US Treasury Proposes Rule Restricting High-Tech Investments in China
summary: The US Department of the Treasury proposed a new rule designed to restrict outbound American investments in high-tech sectors in China and other foreign adversaries.
why: Cross-border investment curbs limit venture capital and private equity flows into strategic tech, including advanced semiconductors and artificial intelligence.

impacts.name: US Venture Capital
impacts.why: Tighter regulatory controls restrict dealmaking and capital allocation into foreign technology companies.
